files.description: Project principles, tech stack, and the commands a change is expected to pass. Go 1.26, testify/require for assertions, `make lint-fix` and `make test` for Go changes, `make helm-tests` for chart changes. Also states that code comments explain why rather than what.
Contribution workflow and the commit and pull request conventions this repository expects.
The exact linter set that already runs on every pull request. Treat every finding these linters produce as already reported, and do not raise it again in review.
How the simulated driver layers fit together, for judging whether a change sits at the right layer.
